profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ AMPEX Data Systems
profile.summary: Hi, I am a graduate of the University of California-Irvine and currently pursuing full-time opportunities. My experience has been mainly in web development, working on the backend and front end. I am expressing an interest in going into the field of machine learning and deep learning as the potential is endless! This was not created by ChatGPT.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading engineer/UX designer on graphical user interface development on both backend, written in C++ with Mongoose for HTTP support, and frontend, written with Typescript on the Vue.js framework.

Led UX development using Figma to design wireframes based on given customer requirements with an emphasis on reusability on previously developed components for newly designed features.

Led meetings with customers on topics concerning the new graphical user interface that is to replace the legacy version.

Developed and released key features for Linux Redhat embedded software integration such as driver installations, data storage quotas, and H.264 video card integrations.

Designed code infrastructure to help replace the current macro-service architecture with a micro-service architecture to assist in scalability and reusability.

Conducted code reviews on a daily basis.

Assisted in creating new documentation outlining design principles and goals for newly developed features along with creating tutorial documentation to assist in streamline production.

Assisted in the refactoring of legacy code and bringing it to modern standards.
positions.insights: Tailwind CSS, Back-End Web Development and +20 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
* Developed regular validation testing for data and feature regression for an annual launch process, affecting over 100 schools, using Ruby on Rails and Sidekiq
* Ensured 100% of edge cases can be caught during pre-launch testing
* Created error monitoring communication pipeline for the engineering scrum team through the integration of Slack, Datadog, and Sentry.io
positions.insights: Ruby, Back-End Web Development and +14 skills

positions.title: Online Computer Science Instructor
positions.description:
Computer Science instructor for idTech's private lessons division.
Taught students under 18 on Python, C++, and Javascript.
positions.insights: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), HTML and +4 skills

positions.title: Robotics Coach
positions.description: Taught 3rd-8th grade students an introduction to physics and Lego EV3 Robotics with programming and design.

volunteerExperiences.description: Event Director of a cooking competition fundraiser for UCICKI(Circle K International's Irvine Division). I set agendas and goals for each member on my committee, communicate with the necessary individuals for event operations, and give advice to committee members when needed. The funds raised go to local food banks.

Activities Coordinator for a cooking competition fundraising event for UCICKI(Circle K Internations' Irvine division). I helped create sustainable cooking workshops and took charge of activities for the participants at the event.
